estimates.assumptions: 2 average boneless skinless chicken breasts (approx 8 oz / 225 g total raw edible portion)
12 oz / 340 g raw carrots, peeled and roasted with minimal oil
5 medium russet potatoes (approx 1.5 lb / 680 g total raw, peeled weight after dicing)
1 medium-large yellow onion (approx 150 g raw, peeled and sliced)
1 unit beef stock concentrate / bouillon (standard single-serve packet or tsp equivalent, ~5-6 g)
2 tbsp butter used in mashed potatoes (standard modest amount for this recipe scale)
1 tsp granulated sugar for onions (modest 'to taste' amount)
approx 1 tbsp total vegetable oil actually absorbed/used across all cooking steps (onions, carrots, chicken)
salt to taste; negligible calories at modest usage
pepper to taste; negligible calories at modest usage
